snapshot_note: Snapshot for tests and as a starting point. SubmitReady re-reads the live guidelines on every run.

requirements.rule: Line numbers on, 2.5 cm margins, US Letter pages
12-point Times, "Normal" style for text and "Heading" styles for headings, left-justified
Sections in order: Abstract, Introduction, Materials & Methods, Results, Discussion, Conclusions, Acknowledgments, References; do not combine sections
First page is an Author Cover Page: title, authors, affiliations and submission admin
Abstract at most 500 words (3,000 characters), with bold run-in subheadings
No footnotes or references in the abstract
Figures uploaded as separate files, not embedded in the manuscript
Figures: PNG (JPEG only for photos) or vector PDF/EPS; ideally 3000 px, at least 900 px; named like "Figure 1.png"
Tables uploaded as separate DOCX files, each fitting on one page
Author-date citations (Name. Year), alphabetical reference list
Supplemental items cited like "Table S1", files named like "Supplemental Data S1"
Funders go in a separate Funding Statement, not in Acknowledgments
Raw data and code are machine-readable, in a repository or as supplemental files under 30 MB; archived code has a persistent identifier
Full species name in italics at first mention
